title: CraftingStick
description: A simple plugin which adds a crafting table on a stick
body:
# CraftingStick

A minimal Minecraft server plugin that adds a "Crafting Stick": a stick item which opens a crafting table UI when used.

## Functionality
- Adds a custom item called Crafting Stick (display name: §6Crafting stick).
- Provides a shaped recipe to craft the Crafting Stick using a Crafting Table and a regular stick.
- Right-clicking (use action) with the Crafting Stick in hand opens a crafting table (workbench) UI for the player.

## Recipe
![alt text](https://github.com/davi-fonto/CraftingStick-Paper/blob/main/img/image.png?raw=true)
![alt text](https://github.com/davi-fonto/CraftingStick-Paper/blob/main/img/image-1.png?raw=true)

## Installation
1. Build the plugin or download the provided JAR.
2. Place `CraftingStick-Paper-1.0.jar` (or the built jar) into your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Start or reload the server.

## Usage
- Craft the Crafting Stick using the in-game recipe
- Right-click while holding the Crafting Stick to open the crafting UI (workbench).
![alt text](https://github.com/davi-fonto/CraftingStick-Paper/blob/main/img/image-2.png?raw=true)

## Compatibility & Notes
- The plugin was developed against Bukkit/Spigot/Paper API (api-version declared in `plugin.yml`).
- Identification of the item relies on item meta internal name set by the plugin. If your server environment modifies item meta handling, the plugin may need adjustments (e.g. using PersistentDataContainer).

That's all — the plugin does exactly one thing: provide a convenient crafting stick to open a crafting table UI.
